title: Build a star schema for a report
objectives: Find what would break a dimension before building it
Build dimensions with surrogate keys, one row per business key
Build a fact table whose every row finds its dimensions

exercises.prompt: Find every customer_id that appears more than once in customers: customer_id and copies, smallest customer_id first.
hints: GROUP BY customer_id and count the rows of each.
HAVING count(*) > 1 keeps only the ones that appear more than once.

exercises.prompt: Make dim_customer (customer_key, customer_id, name, region), dim_product (product_key, product_id, product_name, category) and fact_sales (order_id, customer_key, product_key, date_key INTEGER, quantity, amount) from complete orders, where every sale finds its customer and product. Every order's customer and product exist in this data.
hints: The customer you found in the first exercise gets two customer_key values from the starter. Its copies are exact duplicates here, so SELECT DISTINCT before numbering.
row_number() OVER (ORDER BY customer_id) gives each customer one key. Do the same for products.

fact_sales joins orders to both dimensions on their business keys, and keeps status = 'complete'. date_key is CAST(year(order_date) * 10000 + month(order_date) * 100 + day(order_date) AS INTEGER), as in LM-09.
